AMUSE:
I To entertain the mind agreeably:
(1) वि-नोदयति (c. of नुद्), how shall I a. myself
केनेदानीमात्मानं विनोदयामि, V. ii.;
(2) रञ्जयति
(c. of रञ्ज्), the prince was very much a. ed by []
his long description of his past valour, beauty and
fortune
अतीतस्वशौर्यरूपविभववर्णनावाचालेन तेन सुत-
रामरज्यत राजपुत्रः, K.
II. To delude: q. v.:
छलयति (nomi.).

AMUSEMENT:
(1) विनोदः;
(2) विनोदनम्: v.
Diversion, entertainment.

AMUSING (part. adj.): विनोदिन् (f. नी): v.
Pleasing.
